name: skill-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for engineering work: a development-workflow pipeline from brainstorm to shipped change, the 9-step DDD Starter Modelling Process as a chained pipeline with a bundled diagram renderer, codebase priming, rich diff and PR explainers, wiki generation, security sweeps and generated end-to-end suites, a game-development review board backed by cited rules, multi-agent fleet orchestration, skill and MCP-server authoring, and a toolkit of thinking, discipline and verification skills.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Understand a codebase, then verify it. core primes a repo once — a deterministic zero-token knowledge graph via graphify plus a CORE tree of CLAUDE.md contracts with AGENTS.md symlinks — so later questions cost a graph query instead of a file sweep. explain-diff turns a diff, branch or PR into a self-contained HTML explainer with background, intuition, a code walkthrough and a quiz; it narrates itself, reading its prose aloud with a follow-along player, when a local text-to-speech service is available. deepwiki generates and maintains wiki-style docs with line-level citations and validated Mermaid diagrams. e2e-harness discovers a polyglot system from its own docs and generates runnable end-to-end suites across Node, Python, Go, C#, Rust, Kafka and Playwright. security-sweep orchestrates a multi-agent OWASP, STRIDE, secrets, supply-chain and LLM-security audit with a verifier fan-out and a CSO report. complexity-sweep measures 14 complexity metrics on TypeScript and JavaScript and turns each violation into a refactoring. CORE is adapted from DOX (agent0ai/dox, MIT); explain-diff is adapted from Geoffrey Litt's explain-diff gist.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: A development workflow as a chained skill pipeline over one ai_docs/ workspace: prime the codebase, brainstorm a design, analyze it from eight perspectives, break it into SLC phases, write a zero-context implementation plan, execute it in batches with reviewer subagents or a swarm, verify against the plan, review from eleven perspectives, describe the change, and hand off. Bundles four agents (codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder, code-reviewer). Adapted in part from obra/superpowers, HumanLayer, wshobson/agents and BMAD-METHOD; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: ddd
plugins.description: The 9-step DDD Starter Modelling Process as a chained skill pipeline: understand, discover (EventStorming), decompose (bounded contexts), strategize (core domain chart), connect (message flows), organise (Team Topologies), define (Bounded Context Canvas), code (aggregates, hexagonal), contracts (JSON Schema payloads). Shares one ddd/ workspace with JSON schemas, validators and step gates; every step records its decisions with every option weighed and rebuilds a self-contained review page with SVG/PNG diagrams and decision comparisons, and the run ends with a blueprint final render. Node.js 18 or newer, nothing to install. Includes blueprint, the bundled diagram renderer (architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML) that `ddd export blueprint --deliver` uses and that can be used on its own.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: A review board for game work, backed by cited rules distilled from 38 game-development books: a studio CPO for any 'is this fun' question, plus focused auditors for systems, balance and economy, code architecture, performance and frame budget, and QA and ship-readiness.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run a herdr multi-agent worker fleet: an orchestrator that decomposes work, spawns and assigns workers by tier and integrates results through the horch CLI; the worker side of that protocol; deterministic scripts for driving the herdr terminal workspace manager; and a setup skill that checks the machine and fills only the gaps. Requires the herdr CLI (herdr.dev), which is not bundled.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Cross-cutting skills: divergent ideation, human-sounding prose, spaced-repetition decks, model and subagent routing, an engineering persona, plan verification before and after implementation, and completion discipline for long autonomous runs. Plus eight vendored engineering disciplines: systematic debugging, test-driven development, receiving code review, git worktrees, advanced git workflows, error-handling patterns, code review excellence and API design principles. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see README.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Make more skills and tools. skill-creator builds, evaluates and benchmarks Claude Code skills; mcp-builder guides a well-designed MCP server in Python or TypeScript; harvest clones a GitHub repository you name and installs the skills it finds into your local skills directory. skill-creator and mcp-builder are owned copies of the Apache-2.0 skills from anthropics/skills — see README.
